# Nadon Thai Restaurants

> {{ site.description }}

Nadon Thai is a family-run group of three authentic Thai restaurants in North East England. The restaurants serve freshly prepared traditional Thai food for lunch and dinner, with dine-in, takeaway and collection options. Nadon Thai has operated since 2010.

Opening times are local UK time (Europe/London). Use the official location pages and linked menus for current details; prices, menu availability and holiday hours may change. Newcastle and Durham use resOS booking widgets. Morpeth uses a booking request form; submitting a request is not a confirmed reservation.

## Primary pages

- [Official website]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): Overview of Nadon Thai, its restaurants, food and services.
- [Menu]({{ '/menu/' | absolute_url }}): Food menu overview and links to current location-specific menus.
- [Book a table]({{ '/book-a-table/' | absolute_url }}): Choose a restaurant and make a reservation.
- [Gift vouchers]({{ '/gift-vouchers/' | absolute_url }}): Information about Nadon Thai gift vouchers.
- [Gallery]({{ '/gallery/' | absolute_url }}): Photos of Nadon Thai food and restaurants.
- [Special offers]({{ '/special-offers/' | absolute_url }}): Email signup for restaurant offers.

## Food and services

- Cuisine: authentic Thai food prepared from fresh ingredients and traditional recipes.
- Dining: lunch and dinner at Morpeth, Newcastle and Durham.
- Takeaway: takeaway and collection are available; ordering providers vary by location.
- Menus: evening, lunch, happy hour, takeaway, lunchbox, children's, dessert, gluten-free and vegan, and allergen information are available on the website. Menu availability and prices may vary by restaurant.
- Reservations: use the location-specific booking links above. Contact the restaurant directly for booking questions.
- Gift vouchers: available online and redeemable at all Nadon Thai locations.

## Official contact and social profiles

- General email: {{ site.email }}
- Facebook: {{ site.social.facebook }}
- Instagram: {{ site.social.instagram }}

For the latest availability, menu pricing, opening-hour exceptions and booking confirmation, use the official pages above or contact the relevant restaurant directly.
